plugins.name: management-portal
plugins.description: Operate the management-portal MCP with the full agent discipline — the core loop, the three gates (read-after-write, completeness, task-breakdown), bottom-up completion, never-fabricate-ids, and board-first. Bundles the MCP server, the management-portal skill, the team-chat-reachability skill and its team-chat-watcher sub-agent (an agent that joins a Team Chat channel keeps watching it instead of going deaf after one poll, and a coordinator can claim a titled, token-backed role that workers on the same API key cannot impersonate), the portal-operator subagent, the /portal and /rearm-watch commands, and the read-after-write hooks. Claude Code Desktop prompts for your API key on install; a CLI install does not prompt, so set it under pluginConfigs in settings.json.
